extensionDescription.message: Translate, explain, analyze and proofread text on any webpage across 484 languages, varieties and formal systems.

copyShortcutDescription.message: Copy the currently displayed LingoLens result

sameLanguageWarning.message: Source and target are the same. Translation will be skipped.

geminiKeyMissingFallback.message: Gemini API key is missing — Google Translate will be used as fallback.

geminiKeyMissingNoFallback.message: Gemini API key is missing. Fallback is disabled, so Gemini translation will fail.

deepLKeyMissingFallback.message: DeepL API key is missing — Google Translate will be used as fallback.

deepLKeyMissingNoFallback.message: DeepL API key is missing. Fallback is disabled, so DeepL translation will fail.

settingsSubtitle.message: Translation, historical language periods, languages, API keys and behavior

enabledHelp.message: The keyboard shortcut and toolbar switch control this setting globally.

hoverEnabledHelp.message: Translate the text block directly under the pointer after a short delay.

selectionEnabledHelp.message: Translate the full selected fragment, preserving paragraph and line breaks. Whole-page selections are ignored; use the context menu for full-page translation.

skipEnglishHelp.message: Keeps the original behavior: English is ignored even when the target is another language.

skipUnknownHelp.message: If local language detection is not confident, do not send the text to a translation service.

apiSecurityNote.message: Keys are stored locally in Firefox extension storage. They are not encrypted like passwords.

geminiApiHelp.message: Required for Gemini. If Gemini fails and fallback is enabled, LingoLens uses Google Translate.

deepLApiHelp.message: Required for DeepL. If DeepL fails and fallback is enabled, LingoLens uses Google Translate. Developer uses api-free.deepl.com; Growth uses api.deepl.com.

clearCache.message: Clear translation cache in open tabs

aboutText.message: LingoLens translates text under the pointer and selected fragments, including period-aware historical and ancient languages.

resetConfirm.message: Restore all default settings? Gemini and DeepL API keys will be preserved.

geminiModelHelp.message: Used when Gemini is selected. Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite is the recommended and fastest tested model.

uiLanguageHelp.message: Choose the language used in the LingoLens popup, settings and on-page messages. On first run, Polish Firefox selects Polish; every other Firefox language selects English.

advancedSectionIntro.message: Settings intended for users who want more control over the translation backend.

fallbackEnabledHelp.message: When Gemini or DeepL fails, automatically retry with Google Translate. Disable this to prevent LingoLens from switching translation providers.

fallbackReason_content_blocked.message: content was blocked by the provider

fallbackReason_unsupported_language.message: language is not supported by the selected provider

fallbackReason_unchanged_output.message: provider returned the source text unchanged
